What monthly rupee fee does the banking harness charge account holders?

What are the default entry limit and TTL for each Symposium cache namespace?
What does the Symposium loader validate, and which metadata format replaces pickle deserialization?
Which generation finish state may enter the Symposium cache, and what happens to truncated or tool-call responses?
Does the local Symposium Valkey adapter require a vector-search module or provide an indexed ANN service?
Which two explicit settings run the Symposium app locally without Redis, and what protection is disabled?
What risk does semantic answer reuse introduce, and do request budgets cap total provider spending?
What did the Symposium local SQLite workload measure, and does that result describe hosted production traffic?
What does a Symposium page-citation check establish, and what does it leave unproven?
What exact registration fee in rupees does the fictional Innovate 2026 symposium charge?
How much did the Symposium hosted Redis service invoice the author last month?
How many meeting participants are supported, and how are concurrent joins serialized before enforcing that cap?
What prevents one socket from joining multiple rooms through overlapping requests, and what happens after failed admission?
Which path carries Apna Video Call media, and what does the server coordinate instead?
How are meeting access and refresh tokens stored, and what do refresh and logout change?
What PostgreSQL capability does meeting signaling need, and which connection type should be used?
What relay may Apna Video Call need on restricted networks, and does Vercel supply it?
Where are meeting recordings stored, and is there a server-side recording archive?
Does possession of an Apna Video Call meeting link require approval through a lobby or a room password?
Which directories are the active meeting implementation, and what is the status of backend/?
What does the two-instance meeting integration suite exercise, and does it measure actual camera or microphone quality across networks?
What is the actual TURN password used by the hosted Apna Video Call deployment?
What measured MOS audio-quality score does Apna Video Call achieve on a 3G network?

encoder_input_diagnostics.interpretation: Production encoder truncates each chunk to 256 tokens. Original heading chunking is preserved; BM25 still sees full chunk text.

dataset.label: Authored multi-domain diagnostic dev query partition; not an external benchmark or independent human labels

protocol.aggregation: macro mean over answerable queries; unsupported queries excluded from ranking metrics
protocol.cold_scope: one fresh evaluator process; import and index construction separated; OS/filesystem caches not cleared; first method calls share one index
protocol.latency_scope: local retrieval calls only; excludes HTTP, network, generation, rate limiting and model downloads
protocol.limitations: Five domains from six public repository documents by the same author. Not an external benchmark, independently human-labeled dataset, production traffic or generated-answer evaluation. Domain-separated query diagnostic splits; all documents are available to retrieval. The durable-jobs source describes an implementation lab with undeployed cloud operation. Production retrieval is unchanged apart from explicit corpus injection. No ranking or threshold tuning before this frozen diagnostic. Thirteen of 32 chunks exceed the encoder 256-token limit; complete source chunks remain available to BM25 and generation context.
protocol.relevance: binary; unlisted chunks treated as non-relevant
